title: WAXAL: A Large-Scale Multilingual African Language Speech Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2602.02734v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in speech technology predominantly favor high-resource languages, leaving speakers of Sub-Saharan African languages underserved. To bridge this divide, we introduce WAXAL, an open, large-scale speech dataset spanning 27 African languages representing over 100 million speakers. WAXAL comprises over 14,100 hours of speech collected in partnership with African academic and community organizations to build local research capacity: an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) corpus with 2,340 hours of transcribed, image-prompted natural speech across 19 languages (plus ~11,760 untranscribed hours) and a studio-quality Text-to-Speech (TTS) corpus of ~247 hours across 15 language configurations. We empirically benchmark three architecturally distinct ASR models -- Gemma 3n 2B, Whisper-Large-v3, and MMS-1B-all -- across the 19 ASR languages on strictly speaker-disjoint splits. translated_title: WAXAL：大规模多语言非洲语言语音语料库
translated_abstract: 语音技术的最新进展主要偏向高资源语言，导致撒哈拉以南非洲语言的使用者得不到充分的服务。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了WAXAL，一个开放的大规模语音数据集，涵盖27种非洲语言，代表超过1亿使用者。WAXAL包含超过14,100小时的语音数据，这些数据由非洲学术和社区组织合作收集，旨在建设当地研究能力：其中包括一个自动语音识别（ASR）语料库，含2,340小时的带转录、由图像提示引发的自然语音，覆盖19种语言（另有约11,760小时未转录语音），以及一个录音棚质量的文本转语音（TTS）语料库，约247小时，涵盖15种语言配置。我们在严格的说话者不相交数据划分上，对三种架构截然不同的ASR模型——Gemma 3n 2B、Whisper-Large-v3和MMS-1B-all——在19种ASR语言上进行了实证基准测试。在WAXAL上进行微调带来了显著的性能提升。
tldr: WAXAL是一个涵盖27种非洲语言、超过14,100小时的大规模开放语音数据集，包含ASR和TTS两部分语料，实验证明在其上微调可显著提升多个先进ASR模型的性能，从而弥合语音技术中非洲语言的资源差距。
en_tdlr: WAXAL is an open, large-scale speech corpus spanning 27 African languages and over 14,100 hours, and fine-tuning on it substantially improves state-of-the-art ASR models, helping bridge the speech technology resource gap for African languages.
